केशव दैवज्ञ son of Kamalākara and pupil of Vaidya-
nātha. He was father of Ananta (Kālanirṇayāva-
bodha), Gaṇeśa (Grahalāghava etc.), and Rāma, the
father of Nṛsiṃha (Grahakaumudī, Grahadīpikā). His
son Gaṇeśa mentions in the C. on the Muhūrtatattva
the following works of Keśava:
 Kāyasthādidharmapaddhati, Grahakautuka, Jāta-
kapaddhati and C., Tājakapaddhati, Tithisiddhi,
Muhūrtatattva, Siddhānte Upapattipāṭhanicaya,
See Gaṇakataraṅgiṇī by Sudhākara in Paṇḍit
XIV, p. 173. Sudhākara adds: Kuṇḍāṣṭaka-
lakṣaṇa, Gaṇitadīpikā, Varṣagranthasiddhi
(Siddhantavāsanāpāṭha).
 The Jātakapaddhati is also called Keśavī. Keśavī
bṛhatī B. 4, 166. Laghvī and C. by Viśva-
nātha. K. 224. See Jātakakeśavī.
